newsitem.title: ITALY: Florence offers free buses in bid to beat smog.
newsitem.headline: Florence offers free buses in bid to beat smog.

text.p: Passengers travelled free on Florence's buses for the first time on Thursday as the city, one of Italy's most popular tourist attractions, fought to tame high pollution levels by cutting car traffic.

The council said that only cars built after 1991 with catalytic converters could travel in the city centre. The free public transport and car ban would remain in force on Friday, a city official said.
Rome's city council also announced a partial block on traffic for Friday in the face of high carbon monoxide levels in the Italian capital.
